headline: USMCA, the Only Agreement That Matters
summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said she and US President Donald Trump agreed to advance negotiations on the USMCA trade agreement in December, at the G-20 meeting. The remarks were made in Shenzhen, China.
why: The USMCA governs trade of roughly one-third of US imports from Mexico and Canada, so its review affects tariffs, auto supply chains and cross-border investment.
